race.comment: MR HUGO (5) was heavily supported on debut with a fast finishing fourth over 1100m at this track in a decent rating contest. Can race a touch closer from the inside gate and gets the services of a senior jockey. Hard to hold out. YEAH BUDDY (2) resumed for the new yard with a tough on-pace second over 1100m at this track when he shouldered the 59kg. Will go back from the gate and launch late. DEVIL DANCER (3) was sent to town at his second race start with a battling fifth over 1200m at Canterbury in a Super Maiden. Finds a more appropriate race and ready to show up. PUNXSUTAWNEY PHIL (7) Ole Kirk colt from a Snitzel mare on debut for the O'Shea & Charlton yard. Has trialled well and finds a nice race to make an impression.
